What Is an In-Home Moving Estimate?

Why in-home estimates matter and what they include.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

An in-home estimate lets a mover see the inventory, access, and handling needs before quoting the job.

What to do next

  • Use this advice as a starting point, then confirm the details for your lane or business.
